---
title: "scATAC Quality Control and Integration"
format: html
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---

## Purpose

Filter ATAC cells, run TF-IDF/LSI, cluster, and save a reusable Signac object.

## Packages

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-02-quality-control-integration-packages
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Load only the packages used in this template.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(Signac)
  library(qs2)
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
})
```

## User Config

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-02-quality-control-integration-user-config
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# USER INPUT:
input_object <- "path/to/signac_created.qs"
output_object <- "path/to/signac_integrated.qs"
results_dir <- "results/signac_qc_integration"
figures_dir <- "figures/signac_qc_integration"
assay_name <- "peaks"
sample_column <- "sample_column"
group_column <- "group_column"
min_tss_enrichment <- 2
max_nucleosome_signal <- 4
n_lsi_dims <- 30
cluster_resolution <- 0.5
seed <- 1
n_threads <- 4
compress_level <- 6
```

## Input Loading

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-02-quality-control-integration-input-loading
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Create output folders and load configured inputs.
set.seed(seed)
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
object <- qs2::qs_read(file = input_object, nthreads = n_threads)
DefaultAssay(object) <- assay_name
```

## Validation

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-02-quality-control-integration-validation
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Stop early when required inputs or columns are missing.
stopifnot(inherits(object, "Seurat"))
stopifnot(all(c(sample_column, group_column, "TSS.enrichment", "nucleosome_signal") %in% colnames(object[[]])))
```

## Input Summary

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-02-quality-control-integration-input-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Write a small TSV summary of the loaded input.
readr::write_tsv(tibble::tibble(cells_before = ncol(object), peaks = nrow(object)), file.path(results_dir, "atac_qc_input_summary.tsv"))
```

## Main Analysis

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-02-quality-control-integration-main-analysis
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Run the reusable analysis step for this template.
object$qc_pass <- object$TSS.enrichment >= min_tss_enrichment & object$nucleosome_signal <= max_nucleosome_signal
object <- subset(object, subset = qc_pass)
object <- RunTFIDF(object)
object <- FindTopFeatures(object, min.cutoff = "q0")
object <- RunSVD(object)
object <- FindNeighbors(object, reduction = "lsi", dims = 2:n_lsi_dims)
object <- FindClusters(object, resolution = cluster_resolution)
object <- RunUMAP(object, reduction = "lsi", dims = 2:n_lsi_dims, reduction.name = "umap.atac")
```

## QC Checks

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-02-quality-control-integration-qc-checks
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export checks that make failures easy to inspect.
readr::write_tsv(object[[]] |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id"), file.path(results_dir, "atac_filtered_metadata.tsv"))
```

## Visualization

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-02-quality-control-integration-visualization
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save compact figures for the main outputs.
pdf(file.path(figures_dir, "atac_umap_clusters.pdf"), width = 6, height = 5)
print(DimPlot(object, reduction = "umap.atac", group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE))
dev.off()
```

## Object Result Storage

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-02-quality-control-integration-object-result-storage
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Store reusable analysis metadata inside the object.
object@misc$template <- list(step = "scatac_quality_control_integration", lsi_dims = n_lsi_dims, resolution = cluster_resolution)
```

## Result Export

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-02-quality-control-integration-result-export
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export the main reusable tables as TSV files.
readr::write_tsv(object[[]] |> tibble::as_tibble() |> count(seurat_clusters, .data[[sample_column]], name = "n_cells"), file.path(results_dir, "atac_cluster_counts.tsv"))
```

## Final Save

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-02-quality-control-integration-final-save
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save the updated object for the next template step.
qs2::qs_save(object, file = output_object, nthreads = n_threads, compress_level = compress_level)
```

## Output Summary

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-02-quality-control-integration-output-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Print a compact summary of generated outputs.
tibble::tibble(output_object = output_object, cells = ncol(object), clusters = length(levels(Idents(object))))
```
